name: Corner Notch
description: Each cell takes one random diagonal border on a different edge, like a folded paper corner.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(){ border-top:1px solid var(--color1); transform:rotate(45deg); } @random(){ border-left:1px solid var(--color1); transform:rotate(45deg); } @random(){ border-bottom:1px solid var(--color1); transform:rotate(45deg); } @random(){ border-right:2px solid var(--color1); transform:rotate(45deg); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; grid-gap: -1px; overflow:hidden; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
